documentation.content:
Taxi prediction requests are being rejected with HTTP 422.

Check the request logs and identify invalid or missing fields. Correct the client payload using service/schemas.py, then verify a valid prediction returns HTTP 200. This alert indicates rejected input, not necessarily server failure.

conditions.displayName: More than 5 HTTP 422 responses in a 60-second window

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.project_id="itcs355-6688176" AND resource.labels.location="asia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.service_name="taxi-fare-api" AND metric.type="run.googleapis.com/request_count" AND metric.labels.response_code="422"
